## DISCORD - Subject Switch (M3)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/discord/subject-switch

**Description:** Changement de contexte matiere - When chatbot-core receives `/matiere maths`, it calls azy.mcp to reload the correct expert + RAG + session.

**Request:**
```json
{
  "guild_id": "123456789",
  "user_id": "987654321",
  "thread_id": "111222333",
  "new_subject_slug": "maths"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "previous_subject": "optique",
    "new_subject": "maths",
    "expert": { ... }
  },
  "_trace": { ... }
}
```

**RFC:** RFC-048 (Discord Education Architecture)

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["previous_subject", "new_subject", "expert"],
  "domain": "education"
}
```

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: $json.error, _trace: { service_response: null, latency_ms: Date.now() - $json.startTime } }) }}
